verdict.rationale: Forter supports event-driven automation via webhooks (real-time notifications on events like disputes/chargebacks) and configurable decision behaviors (e.g., Auto Invoice triggering capture), and its MCP interface lets an AI agent perform actions like reviewing decisions or updating policies via natural language. However, there is no evidence of a user-facing rule-definition engine (e.g., 'if X then Y' conditions) that AI-native users can author themselves. Missing for 10: explicit rule-builder/conditional logic UI or API, examples of user-defined trigger-action pairs beyond fixed webhook events and preset decision toggles.
